listings.rawTitle: Aramis Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray 10 ml
listings.description: With Intuition Eau de Parfum Spray, Aramis presents a modern evolution of the traditional art of fragrance, which is technically categorised as Woody Green Neo-Fougère. Launched in 2025, this creation skilfully combines green accents with a woody depth and stands for contemporary elegance. The olfactory opening is characterised by a crisp grapefruit note that lends the fragrance an immediate, citrusy clarity. Aromatic lavender then unfolds at the centre of the composition, creating a harmonious link to the more complex base notes as a classic element. The foundation of earthy vetiver and the special Cuirissima LXR, an exclusive accord that creates a warm and leathery signature, is particularly influential for the character of the perfume. Accompanying nuances of patchouli, amber and orris round off the fragrance experience and lend it a subtle persistence. Visually, the purity of the fragrance is reflected in a slim, cylindrical bottle made of transparent glass, which reveals the clear liquid. A silver cap and vertical lettering on the front complete the minimalist design. The projection of the eau de parfum changes from an initial freshness to a subtle, body-hugging warmth as it is worn. Fragrance family: Woody Green Neo-Fougère with woody and green facets. Top notes of tangy grapefruit and heart notes with aromatic lavender. Base note with earthy vetiver and exclusive Cuirissima LXR leather accord. Minimalist, cylindrical glass bottle with silver cap. Evolution from citrusy freshness to warm, leathery depth.

listings.description: With its expressive fragrance composition, Aramis Intuition Intense Eau de Parfum Spray emphasises a confident presence in everyday business life as well as at evening events. The fragrance is presented in an elegant, deep-blue glass bottle with a contrasting silver cap. Immediately after spraying, the combination of juniper berry and black pepper imparts a spicy freshness that can create a pleasantly invigorating sensation. As the fragrance develops, lavender and osmanthus reveal their aromatic facets, lending the composition a harmonious depth. This intense formulation offers a long-lasting fragrance experience, meaning that reapplication during the day is often unnecessary. The base notes of oakwood, vanilla and the characteristic Aramis leather essence round off the profile and leave a warm, memorable impression. The fine spray nozzle allows the perfume to be dispensed precisely and sprayed evenly. listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray 30 ml
listings.description: The composition of Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum Spray is characterised by a sophisticated balance of floral, woody and musky elements that embody a modern yet timeless aesthetic. The olfactory experience opens with a top note full of character, combining the fruity freshness of green apple and bergamot with the subtle spiciness of black pepper, purple freesia and nutmeg oil. As the fragrance progresses, a multi-layered heart unfolds, combining classic floral accords of white jasmine, rose and violet with the delicate nuances of hibiscus and heliotrope to create a harmonious bouquet. The complex base note, which combines the woody depth of sandalwood and cedarwood with incense, labdanum and a velvety suede accord and musk, ensures a long-lasting and warm finish. The design of the bottle picks up on this clear line visually: A slender, rectangular glass body with rounded corners and pale yellow contents is topped by a cylindrical cap with a textured, gold-coloured surface. On the front, the characteristic gold-coloured crocodile logo is emblazoned on a vertical label, discreetly underlining the affiliation with the brand. Created by Olivier Cresp, this fragrance stands for an understated elegance that radiates creativity and a sense of style. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Eau de Toilette Spray Mirto di Panarea 50 ml
listings.description: Panarea: The smallest and oldest Aeolian island radiates peace and tranquillity. Fragmented bays, bordered by luminous olive groves, are lapped by emerald-green waters. The myrtle plant grows among wild pistachios, agaves and broom. Even the goddess Venus wanted to adorn herself with a myrtle wreath when she was chosen by Paride. Myrtle has always symbolised beauty and love, and in the Middle Ages its fragrance was known as "angel's water". The fragrance of Mirto di Panarea caresses the skin and soul with a pleasant, intensely regenerating breeze from the Italian Mediterranean. The unmistakable scent of myrtle spreads slowly and pleasantly. The fragrance opens with an elegant, sparkling top note, characterised by citrus accents such as Calabrian lemon and sweet orange. It is emphasised by the simple and unadulterated aroma of basil. The heart note unfolds a blossoming core of velvet and elegance, where accents of jasmine, rose and lilac meet a light sea breeze and traces of blackcurrant. A feeling of deep well-being that reaches its full perfection in the woody base note with the aromatic scents of wild pistachio and juniper as well as cedarwood and amber.

listings.description: The Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray from the Signatures Of The Sun fragrance line by Acqua di Parma combines exquisite spices with warm woody and appealing oriental fragrance accords. With spirited pepper and elegant agarwood The Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray is a self-confident fragrance for men, based on a slightly tart base, which is livened up by sparkling fruity nuances in the top note. An exquisite blend of spices rounds off the fragrance, which has been available since 2021, and gives it temperament. Upon application, Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Oud & Spice Eau de Parfum Spray initially envelops you in an invigorating blend of tangy bergamot and seductive raspberries, which combine with an elegant rose nuance. The heart note consists of pink pepper , cloves and cinnamon and gives the creation strength and an excitingly passionate tone. The base has a gentle and calming effect: warm agarwood meets creamy ladan resin and oriental patchouli, which has a pleasantly rough and masculine effect.

listings.description: Sandalo is a fresh and woody eau de parfum spray from the exclusive Milanese boutique Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2016, the unisex fragrance is characterised by a harmonious composition full of elegance and freshness . Very precious and rare sandalwood from India, which is characterised by the particular richness and intensity of its aromas, is the olfactory theme of this perfume. The multi-faceted fragrance of petit grain, the oil from the leaves of the bitter orange, is joined by sparkling notes of subtly tart bergamot, ripe lemon and juicy orange. In the heart note, Acqua di Parma Sandalo Eau de Parfum Spray presents an irresistible play of colours and aromas. The intense, unmistakable scent of lavender from Provence is given additional character and depth by spicy, creamy accents of cardamom. In the base of the fragrance, the precious sandalwood impressively brings its elegance to the fore. Delicious, opulent tonka bean and soft ambergris bring this enchanting eau de parfum spray to an impressive close with a hint of irresistible sensuality. A unisex perfume that fascinates with its sophisticated composition and the intensity of its notes.

listings.description: The Eau de Parfum Spray Oud is a new fragrance from Acqua di Parma. Of course, both woody-spicy fragrances are men's fragrances, but some women also like to wear them. The eau de parfum spray from Acqua di Parma is naturally significantly stronger in its presence and has enormous longevity and sillage, just as you would expect from an eau de parfum spray from the traditional Milanese brand. A fragrance that definitely stands out The top note of Acqua di Parma perfume begins with Italian orange and Calabrian bergamot. It gives way to heart notes of Russian coriander, Haitian amyris and, of course, precious oud. In the almost opulent base, the flavours of Atlas cedar meet Indonesian patchouli, fine sandalwood and musk. The result is a noble masculine composition that is particularly suitable for wearing on cooler days, but can also be worn on summer evenings. Acqua di Parma Oud is a fragrance that flatters the modern man of today. This is because the fragrance has a clear but not overpowering presence.

listings.description: The Colonia Quercia fragrance dates back to 2016 and was released as an eau de parfum spray by Acqua di Parma in 2019. The fragrance of the masculine eau de parfum spray is spicy and woody . It is debatable whether the perfume is more of a unisex fragrance or a men's fragrance. However, you won't argue about the elegant composition, the chic black bottle or the enormous longevity and sillage. Querica by Acqua di Parma is not an eau de parfum spray for everyone. The fragrance is aimed at people who are looking for the extraordinary , but don't want to find it in screamingly loud compositions. They are not looking for a fragrance with rough edges, but something expressive. Intensity sends its regards The top note of Acqua di Parma Quercia consists of pink pepper, petitgrain, lemon and bergamot. The heart note combines rose geranium, cardamom and cedarwood. Patchouli, tonka bean absolute and oakmoss absolute round off the eau de parfum. Acqua di Parma Quercia is suitable for everyday wear, but can also be worn in the evening. The eau de parfum spray has the all-round qualities typical of the Milanese label, which is aimed at the modern man of today, who feels just as comfortable in jeans as in a suit.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Signatures Of The Sun Eau de Parfum Spray Osmanthus 50 ml
listings.description: Acqua di Parma Osmanthus is a floral-fruity unisex perfume from 2019. The eau de parfum spray is a wonderful addition to the 'Signature of the Sun' fragrance line, which presents particularly precious olfactory ingredients against a radiant, sun-drenched backdrop. Acqua di Parma Osmanthus invites you to take an unforgettable walk through the green forest landscape of south-east Asia . This is the home of the shrub from whose flowers the irresistibly fruity-scented absolute that gives the eau de parfum spray its name is extracted. Its delicate, delicious peach aromas carry subtle nuances of wood and leather and ensure elegant sensuality. An elegant floral fragrance with a sparkling opening Acqua di Parma Osmanthus opens sparkling and fresh with juicy, green mandarin from Sicily and fragrant neroli oil, which powerfully reveals its citrusy richness. The top note brings subtly sensual accents into play. The floral fragrance of delicate peony is joined by beguiling ambrette with its soft, creamy musky scent. A hint of pink pepper discreetly limits the intense notes and gives the eau de parfum spray a fascinating tingle. In the base of the perfume, the star of the show, the osmanthus fragrance, unfolds all its magic. Mossy, woody patchouli supports its sensual elegance with mossy, woody accents.

listings.description: The citrus-aromatic Eau de Parfum Spray Yuzu is the latest member of the 'Frutti d'Oro' family from the traditional luxury perfume house Acqua di Parma. Launched in 2019, the unisex fragrance by French star perfumers Nicolas Bonneville and François Demachy is dedicated to Japan's most delicious fruit , the yuzu. Its unique, bitter-sweet aroma combines with the citrusy accents so typical of Acqua di Parma fragrances to create a tingling, fresh fragrance experience with an addictive character. A sparkling fragrance with plenty of elegance and a touch of sensuality The Eau de Parfum Spray opens with a revitalising cocktail in which an intense yuzu accent is joined by the aromas of juicy bergamot from Calabria and sparkling Szechuan pepper. Delicate, graceful blossoms unfold their magic in the heart of the perfume. It presents an elegant, white bouquet of noble lotus, delicate mimosa and fragrant jasmine, gently framed by a green nuance of violet leaf. The extraordinary base of the Eau de Parfum Spray from Acqua di Parma is decidedly sensual. Soft, warm musk, precious sandalwood and liquorice and a hint of liquorice bring the fragrance to an impressive close.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Eau de Toilette Spray 50 ml
listings.description: Cool Water Night Dive: Fresh in a new way Davidoff stands for quality and innovative men’s fragrances without doubt. With the perfume Cool Water Night Dive perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has succeeded in creating a perfume that is a cut above the rest. Hérault learnt his trade from scratch with Pierre Bourdon, who created a milestone with Cool Water in the history of perfumery a quarter of a century ago. The Eau de Toilette Spray from Davidoff that is currently conquering the market is paying homage to the great master. A clear and sensual perfume for men The new scent is green-oriental, a vital prerequisite for the mysterious aura that surrounds this otherwise cool and composed perfume. The basis of the scent is the wood of the pistachio , an extremely valuable and rarely used raw material that is also known as mastic wood. The precious Eau de Toilette Spray develops opening with a note of fresh fruit and mint that is an ideal match for the sensual woody note. A hint of cashmere adds an oriental component to the mix. The successful composition is rounded off through typically male ingredients such as amber, sage, black pepper, tobacco and musk. And yet, words alone can’t do it justice. Cool Water Night Dive from Davidoff is a clear enticement to get a sniff of it.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Lily 75 ml
listings.description: Dolce Lily celebrates the charisma of the pink lily - a symbol of femininity and tenderness since time immemorial. Sandalwood grounds the composition with its own depth, and vanilla tones allow the composition to linger long on the skin. The bottle picks up on the feminine elegance of the original Dolce silhouette, but now dresses in a bold pink, from which the vivacious personality of the Dolce girl shines out into the world. The familiar floral cap comes in the same vibrant pink and anticipates the fresh lily accord of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense 30 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana awakens the queen in you ! With Q by Dolce&Gabbana Eau de Parfum Spray Intense, you can emphasise your feminine and self-confident style. listings.rawTitle: Dolce&Gabbana Dolce Eau de Toilette Spray Rose 50 ml
listings.description: Dolce&Gabbana Beauty adds another flower to the Dolce bouquet: DOLCE ROSE. The lively and beguiling eau de toilette shows the world another facet of the Dolce girls. Bold, optimistic and sociable, they say what they think and light up the streets with their feminine spontaneity. Dolce Rose captures this carefree joy in a fragrance that is as powerful and spirited as any Dolce Girl. The first eau de toilette in the Dolce collection, Dolce Rose celebrates the queen of flowers, a symbol of love, beauty and femininity and a signature motif in Dolce&Gabbana's work. Created by master perfumer Violaine Collas, the fragrance combines delicate rose absolute and fresh centifolia notes with soft musk and tangy redcurrant. Full of energy and joie de vivre, Dolce Rose is an irresistibly enchanting composition. Intense fruity top notes open the composition in a triad of fresh green apple, juicy mandarin and tangy redcurrant. In the heart note, white peach appeals to our sense of taste and opens our senses to a floral bouquet of velvety magnolia blossoms and majestic roses. The unique character of the fragrance is created from a composition of two rose notes: The dewy clarity of a centifolia essence combines with the soft sensuality of rose absolute to create an unmistakable rose fragrance. This powerful note is embedded in a mantle of soft musk tones, to which sandalwood and other noble light wood notes lend a beguilingly sensual quality. The bottle shares its soft curves and elegantly feminine silhouette with the original Dolce fragrance, but now dips its glass in a rose-red colour in which the eponymous blossom seems to glow. The unmistakable flower cap is now also dressed in a bold red colour that expresses the personality of the Dolce girl and the fascinating facets of the fragrance.

Paco Rabanne takes us into a glittering, sensually intoxicating world of celebration. Lady Million Eau My Gold! is composed around the vibration of mango and the tangy freshness of grapefruit. The absolutes of violet leaf and orange blossom give the floral heart note something wonderfully sparkling. Finally, cedarwood and ambery musk notes unfold their sensuality, igniting a firework of freshness.
